test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is 'Intregue'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling is **Intrigue.**
 
• The meaning of this correctly spelt word** 'Intrigue'** is to make somebody very interested and wanting to know more.
 
 
• **Example:** *The novel examines the world of chaos and **intrigue** of the professional spy.*
 
 
 
• All other options have correct spellings. Hence, they can't be selected as our correct answer.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
